messages:
Security Ops: @here Heads-up: new enforcement for service credentials. Starting after a 14-day grace period we will automatically revoke service tokens that have TTLs > 24h (legacy long-lived tokens). This is a coordinated change to reduce blast radius for leaked credentials. Required actions below. :rotating_light:

Maria Chen: Quick q — does this affect service account keys stored in vaults or only tokens issued by our internal token service?

Security Ops: It targets tokens issued by our internal token service (svc-tokens) and any static API keys recorded in the token inventory. If you have vaulted credentials with automatic rotation < 24h, you are fine. If not, please rotate to short-lived or OIDC-based flows.

Aj Patel: We have a few CI jobs still using static deploy keys. We'll migrate them to OIDC this week. Any recommended GH Actions snippet?

Security Ops: Example GH Actions snippet (AWS OIDC) you can use:
```
steps:
  - name: Configure AWS OIDC
    uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v2
    with:
      role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/github-actions
      aws-region: us-west-2
```
Also see the migration doc: https://internal.redwood/sec/ephemeral-tokens (check the checklist at the top).

Lina Gomez: What about internal ephemeral tokens used by legacy batch jobs? Some can't easily use OIDC.

SRE oncall: For batch jobs that run on-prem or outside GH, open a ticket to SRE (tag: #ephemeral-exception). We will evaluate and either help instrument short-lived tokens or grant a time-limited exception. Exceptions must have compensating controls (IP allowlist, HSM/KMS usage, strong logging).

Maria Chen: Is there a way to find which services still have long-lived tokens?

Security Ops: Yes run this quick query on the token inventory (only for owners with inventory access):
```
SELECT service, token_id, ttl_days, owner
FROM service_tokens
WHERE ttl_days > 1
ORDER BY ttl_days DESC;
```
If you see entries for your service, file a rotation ticket and mark it "ephemeral-migration".

Aj Patel: Understood. Will roll CI changes and ping here when done.

SRE oncall: Note: automated revocation will run in two waves — a dry-run audit next Tuesday, enforced revocation after the 14-day grace window. We'll post the exact dry-run time when scheduled.

Security Ops: TL;DR action items: 1) Audit your service tokens in the inventory, 2) Migrate to OIDC or short-lived tokens (<24h), 3) Open exception tickets if migration impossible, 4) Rotate any static keys immediately. Questions?

deploy-bot: policy-change created: service-token-ephemeralization (id: pc-2026-04). See https://internal.redwood/policies/pc-2026-04 for the formal policy and CSV of impacted services.

Maria Chen: Thanks — will start rotation today. :thumbsup:

Lina Gomez: Opening ticket for our batch pipeline now.

SRE oncall: If you need pairing help, ping me directly.

Security Ops: We'll follow up with a short checklist doc and a live Q&A session schedule. Thanks all.
